ui_bugs.issue: For Club/Org (account_type='partner') accounts, the Profile hero renders TWO chips because ACCOUNT_TYPE_LABELS['partner']='Community Partner' collides with the tierBadge computed from subscription_tier. Observed: FP (PSSS) renders both 'Community Partner' AND 'Founding Partner' chips. Free org (testmoborg) renders both 'Community Partner' AND 'Free' chips. CP (iter69org) happens to render only one chip because label==tierBadge and the dedupe at profile.tsx:438 kicks in. Spec says every org Profile shows exactly ONE tier chip ('Founding Partner' / 'Community Partner' / 'Free'). Fix: in /app/mobile/src/lib/format.ts:35 change ACCOUNT_TYPE_LABELS.partner from 'Community Partner' to 'Club / Org' (match web ACCOUNT_LABEL), OR in /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:437-442 hide the account-type chip when account_type==='partner' (always show only the tier chip for orgs). Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:438-441 and /app/mobile/src/lib/format.ts:35.

rca of the issue: Mobile Profile hero at profile.tsx:437-442 renders TWO Badge nodes: one with the account_type label and one with the tierBadge, deduped only when the two strings are equal. Because ACCOUNT_TYPE_LABELS.partner is hard-coded to 'Community Partner' in /app/mobile/src/lib/format.ts, every Club/Org account whose subscription_tier is NOT exactly 'community_partner' ends up with two chips: FP (tier='founding_partner' → tierBadge='Founding Partner') and Free (tier='free' → tierBadge='Free'). The web uses a different label (ACCOUNT_LABEL.partner = 'Club / Org') AND, on the public page, renders them XOR, so web is correct and mobile is the deviation. Mitigation (one-line): change ACCOUNT_TYPE_LABELS.partner to 'Club / Org' to match web; even better, in profile.tsx hide the account-type chip entirely for partner accounts so the tier chip is the only one rendered.
